body.name: H_one
body.def: \(\mathfrak H_{1,3}\) reproduces the vanishing ideal of the complete modified order-three map, computes \(J_{1,3}:s_{1,3}^{\infty}\), factors its eliminated beta polynomial, and for the factor distinct from the observable contraction root computes an exact real-infeasibility certificate against \(\mathcal R^{\mathrm{legal}}_{1,3}\); it also produces \(\Psi_3,\Psi_2^{+},\Psi_2^{-}\) with exact rational atoms and weights.
